_comment: One build123d Studio release pins one uv and one CPython. Both move only when
the application is rebuilt and retested, so a given release is a fixed support
target rather than whatever happened to be current on the day a user first
The uv checksums are the trust anchor for the download and are checked on every
install. They are recorded here rather than fetched, because the .sha256 files
published beside the archives sit on the same release page as the archives: they
prove a download is intact, not that it is the artifact we tested against.
To move the pin, run scripts/pin-uv.mjs - it re-derives every checksum and
verifies provenance before rewriting this file. Do not edit the digests by hand.
